build:
modctl modelfile generate .

modctl build \
    -t registry.com/models/llama3:v1.0.0 \
    -f Modelfile .
push:
modctl login -u YOUR_USERNAME registry.com

modctl push \
    registry.com/models/llama3:v1.0.0
pull:
modctl pull \
    registry.com/models/llama3:v1.0.0

modctl extract \
    registry.com/models/llama3:v1.0.0 \
    --output ./my-model
